bio.text: James Hooper is the Republican candidate for Michigan's 12th Congressional District in the November 2026 election; he previously ran for the seat in 2024.
According to his campaign website, he grew up on Detroit's east side, worked in the building trades, and is a precinct delegate.
The same site says he did mission work with Samaritan's Purse in Liberia.

sources.title: U.S. House, 12th District - Michigan Advance Voter Guide: 2026 Michigan General Election
